evals.name: todo-overlay
evals.prompt: In my project I want an omp slash command /todos that pops up a native Tern dialog listing every TODO/FIXME comment in the repo grouped by file (count badge per file). Selecting one and pressing a button should open that file at the line in a split pane to the right. It has to keep working when I run omp in plain Windows Terminal. Put the extension in ./todos-ext/.
evals.expected_output: An omp extension with an overlay that has describe plus a render fallback, a list/item with keys, a button plus key handling, and `tern open --split right path:line` gated on the Tern env.
expectations: has-describe-and-render-fallback: every object literal or class with describe( also has render(
harness-describe-runs: describe-harness.ts <entry> --command todos exits 0
memo-stable: the harness prints memo-stable: true
timers-cleared-on-dispose: if setInterval is used, clearInterval appears in dispose
keyboard-twin-for-actions: there is a handleInput with escape handling
exec-uses-argv: no pi.exec of sh/bash/cmd and no shell string
tern-cli-gated: TERM_PROGRAM and TERN_PANE are checked before the tern exec
overlay-role: nativeOverlay has a role

evals.name: git-dashboard-screen
evals.prompt: make me a full-screen tern dashboard for omp (/gitdash) that shows the current branch, ahead/behind, a table of changed files with status badges and a sparkline of commits per day for the last 14 days; refresh every 5s; esc closes. extension goes in ./gitdash/
evals.expected_output: A fullscreen overlay with describeScreen (main/dock), a timer cleared on dispose, a memoized describe, table/chart, and data from pi.exec("git", ...) argv.
expectations: has-describe-and-render-fallback: every object literal or class with describe( also has render(
harness-describe-runs: describe-harness.ts <entry> --command gitdash exits 0
memo-stable: the harness prints memo-stable: true
timers-cleared-on-dispose: if setInterval is used, clearInterval appears in dispose
keyboard-twin-for-actions: there is a handleInput with escape handling
exec-uses-argv: no pi.exec of sh/bash/cmd and no shell string
uses-describeScreen-with-dock: describeScreen returns main and dock

evals.name: branch-status-plugin
evals.prompt: Write a Tern plugin (not an omp extension) that shows the current git branch of the focused pane in Tern's status line and adds a command palette entry 'Copy branch name'. Put it in ./branch-plugin/ and tell me how to install it.
evals.expected_output: plugin.toml with schema = 1 and a valid id, a window.luau using tern.chrome.status and tern.command, tern.process.run with argv for git, and install instructions using tern plugin link.
expectations: manifest-valid: schema = 1, id matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$, and name, version and a host/window entry are present
uses-chrome-status: tern.chrome.status is called
uses-tern-command: tern.command is called
process-run-argv: tern.process.run is called with an array argv
no-require-tern: the code never calls require("tern")
install-instructions-link: the summary or README mentions tern plugin link
